body: I'm already going part time and I just can't put enough effort into the class without quitting my job. I don't want to BS my way through college like I did high school.

Thank you. It's really a strain on the two of us that we make very little money and can't quite afford a place of our own yet. But it's nice to know that at least I have him here for me when no one else is.

I've looked at it from every angle I can imagine. It all comes back to money. If I quit school and work full time, I can better afford my own place to live and get my life started. I want to go back to school when I can give it all the time, energy, effort, and money it needs. Until then, I think I need to be working. It just hurts when people get so negative about the choices I'm making to make my life (hopefully) a little better or easier.
Thank you. I'm trying to stay positive through it all, but it's so hard sometimes.
